8 Aesthetic Desk Setup Ideas for 2025
FEBRUARY 28, 2025

If you’re looking for aesthetic and minimalist desk setups, then you’re in the right place. However, what exactly is an aesthetic desk setup you may wonder? If something is aesthetic, it is pleasant and nice to look at - which is exactly what you might want your office desk to be. 

At Order Office Furniture, we’re a leading supplier of home office desks and other office essentials. Therefore, we know a thing or two about keeping your office desk looking aesthetically pleasing. In this blog, we’ve got 8 of our favourite aesthetic desk setups that will enhance productivity and keep your desk area looking spick and span. 

Let’s get into it! 

Aesthetic desk setups for every office

When it comes to the perfect desk setup, the style and accessories you choose totally depends on your own personal preferences and the things you like. Many people choose to make their office desk a reflection of their personality, adding personal touches for a customisable approach. 

Whether you work from a small room in your house or head into the office, there are plenty of ways that you can make your desk look more aesthetically pleasing. Below, we’ve got 8 of our favourite aesthetic desk setup ideas that you can hopefully take some inspiration from. 

Before we start, have you made sure that you’ve chosen an office desk that will suit your style? The process of choosing a desk can be daunting, but we’ve got a blog: How To Choose The Perfect Office Desk that includes more information. 

Without further ado, let’s have a look at our ideas in a bit more detail… 

1. Pick a white colour theme 

It doesn’t get more minimalistic than a white office desk. Offering a clean and versatile blank canvas, this is a great choice for creating an aesthetic desk setup. A white desk shines in a minimalistic setting, and you can keep this theme by only keeping essential items on your desk and utilising drawers or shelves for storage. A few carefully chosen decorative elements such as a small plant or a picture frame can add personality without overwhelming the space. 

Top tip: ensure you keep up to date with dusting! White shows every mark, smudge, and speck of dust, so regular cleaning is essential to keep an aesthetic look. 

2. Be influenced by biophilic design 

As we head into 2025, biophilia is predicted to be one of the biggest design trends for the year. Biophilic design is all about bringing the outdoors in, creating a desk space that connects you with nature. This can be easily achieved with the addition of plants of all shapes and sizes. You can consider a small potted plant, a hanging planter, or even a small terrarium if you’ve got the space. 

It’s even been found that having house plants in an office can improve well-being, concentration, and productivity by 47%! (Source: National Library of Medicine) Plants are also incredibly aesthetically pleasing to look at, blending into your aesthetic desk theme perfectly. 

3. Add artistic expressions 

Whatever your aesthetic is, there are several ways that you can inject your personality into your office desk. You can showcase your favourite art, print, paintings, or frame personal pictures of your loved ones. To add an artistic touch, use handcrafted organisers such as ceramic pen holders or woven baskets that can act as extra storage. Souvenirs and small trinkets can also add an aesthetic touch to your desk setup. 

If you’re looking for some more inspiration, check out our blog - 7 Ways to Uniquely Decorate Your Office Desk. 

4. Improve your lighting

Another great way to inject an aesthetic appeal into your desk setup is to think about the lighting that you use. Did you know that lighting affects your mood? Natural light has the potential to enhance people’s mood, creativity, and cognitive performance, while warm lighting helps to create a cosy and social atmosphere, great for enhancing a pleasant aesthetic. Cool lighting is better for a focused area that will help you concentrate better. 

Top tip: add a decorative touch to your desk by placing LED strip lights underneath it, or opt for a string of fairy lights for a cosy and warm vibe. 

5. Choose a standing desk 

Deciding to choose a standing or electric desk means that you’re opting for a modern and sleek aesthetic. A standing desk primarily promotes better posture and movement and can allow you to switch between standing and sitting during your working hours. This can promote a healthier workstyle, which can also contribute to a more positive and uplifting desk environment. 

If you’re feeling undecided about a standing desk, have a read of our blog: Are Standing Desks Worth It to find out for yourself. 

6. Pick accessories wisely 

To match your minimalistic look, choose simple and functional accessories in neutral colours. Complimented colours help to add harmony and structure to your desk, as well as making it easy on the eye. For an ergonomic approach, ensure that you’ve got a comfortable mouse and keyboard, as well as an office chair that is the right height and compliments your body shape. 

Top tip: invest in office storage that matches your aesthetic. Keeping your desk organised is another way to enhance its aesthetics, and means that you’re dealing with less clutter and mess. 

7. Reduce your cable clutter 

Cable clutter is the enemy of a clean and aesthetic desk set up! Tangled wires not only look messy but can also be distracting and frustrating. We recommend using cable management boxes to hide power strips and excess cords, keeping them out of sight and offering a neater appearance around your desk.

At Order Office Furniture, we have plenty of solutions when it comes to cable management. Whether you’re after a cable management spine, or an under desk cable tray, rely on us to keep those pesky and cluttered cables at bay - after all, they aren’t the most aesthetic thing to look at. 

8. Keep your desk clean and maintained 

Our final and perhaps most important aesthetic desk setup is to keep it clean and tidy. A cluttered desk can be visually overwhelming and distracting, making it harder to focus on work or creative tasks. A clean and tidy workspace promotes more mental clarity and can allow you to concentrate on the task to hand. You don’t have to do anything too strenuous - a quick dust and polish every week should do the trick. 

Have a read of our blog: Office Storage Ideas for Your Home for more organisation tips. 

Invest in an aesthetic office desk with Order Office Furniture 

Choosing a new office desk setup doesn’t need to be expensive or complicated, especially if you want it to look aesthetic and minimalistic. Order Office Furniture is the place to go for all your office essentials, offering everything you need to increase productivity and work from a space that you love.
